## Task
`confirmed_metric_extracted_payload_scorecard_v1_20260526`

## Lane
Primary lane: Evaluation  
Supporting lanes: Financial Truth, Provenance, Reporting  
Mode: audit / safe-extension planning

## Finding
The system has confirmed metric expectations, but broad runtime accuracy remains DATA_MISSING because extracted payloads are not being scored against those expectations. The existing no-regression gate proves a narrow Appendix 5B floor; it does not prove full metric accuracy across all supported fields or tickers.

## Evidence
Audit artifacts from `reports/agent_jobs/metric_extraction_system_audit_v1_20260526/` show:

- `confirmed_metric_coverage_scorecard.json`: 146 confirmed/candidate metric expectations across 15 fixtures.
- 73 expectations are scored-ready.
- 70 expectations still require candidate review.
- 3 expectations are ambiguous.
- The canonical and expanded profile scorecards without extracted actuals quarantine all documents; they are inventory/evidence checks, not runtime accuracy proof.

Prior preserved evidence says the same thing:

- `reports/agent_jobs/confirmed_metric_scoring_gap_safe_extension_v1_20260524/confirmed_metric_scoring_gap_report.json` records `accuracy_score_status=DATA_MISSING` when no extracted payloads are supplied.
- `reports/agent_jobs/metric_extraction_broad_accuracy_controller_v1_20260524/status.json` records that broad accuracy is unsupported without extracted-payload scoring.

Current supported real-gold hard scoring is also narrow: `canonical_core` and `expanded_required` currently score `revenue`, `operating_cash_flow`, and `net_debt`, while production extraction/persistence handles a wider set of metric fields.

## Duplicate check
Adjacent existing trackers were reviewed and are not exact duplicates:

- #37 is closed and covered the initial gold metric coverage audit.
- #63 is closed and documented the extracted-payload scoring gap, but does not keep the current implementation follow-up visible.
- #73 is the broad parent tracker.
- #74 tracks Appendix 5B no-regression gate refresh, not full confirmed-metric extracted-payload scoring.

This issue is specifically the implementation/reporting follow-up to generate a source-bound extracted-payload scorecard for confirmed metric coverage.

## Required task card
`docs/agent_tasks/confirmed_metric_extracted_payload_scorecard_v1_20260526.md`

## Required report
`reports/agent_jobs/confirmed_metric_extracted_payload_scorecard_v1_20260526/`

## Required checks
- run the current extractor against the confirmed source-bound fixture set or a clearly documented subset;
- feed extracted payloads into the profile scorecard path rather than scoring empty actuals;
- preserve profile separation: `canonical_core`, `expanded_required`, and `confirmed_metric_coverage`;
- report per-field exact match, tolerance, missing, null, abstain, and unsupported counts;
- keep candidate-review metrics out of hard pass/fail until approved;
- prove that Appendix 5B no-regression still passes after any scorecard changes;
- mark unsupported claim families as DATA_MISSING, not verified conclusions.

## Forbidden
- no production DB/Qdrant/news/memory mutation;
- no canonical financial truth mutation;
- no gold-label promotion without source/page/line evidence and approval;
- no parser routing or extraction prompt changes in this scorecard task;
- no broad accuracy claim from inventory-only artifacts.

## Definition of done
A checked-in report proves current extracted-payload accuracy for the approved confirmed metric profile, or this issue remains open with the exact missing payload/source blockers and DATA_MISSING status.
